title: FileWriteCompleted
description: Result: an existing file under the File Storage Adapter's watch_dir was updated (Design.md Decision #19) — always in reply to a FileWriteRequested whose path already existed. eventDetails.correlationId is set to that request's eventId. Unlike FileCreateCompleted, this is never published outside the command flow — there's no 'externally-triggered update' detection in v1 (Design.md §9, deferred).

path.description: File path, relative to watch_dir, that was updated.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the file's content in bytes, after the write.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601) the write completed.
